name: Signteer
author: plainware

sections.description:
Signteer is a lightweight volunteer sign-up sheets plugin designed to help your organization keep track of volunteer opportunities, tasks and sign-ups.

Features:

  • Admins can post sign-up sheets with permalinks.
  • Volunteers can sign up directly from the sheet page.
  • Admins can control the tasks for each sign-up sheet and number of spots for each task.
  • Admins can view the list of all volunteers with the history of their involvement.

Support

Please contact us at https://www.signteer.com/

Author: Plainware
Author URI: https://www.signteer.com

1. Install the plugin via the WordPress backend or upload the plugin files through FTP.
